localReport.title: Miss Belmar Princess-Northern New Jersey
localReport.summary: Our last report of the week comes from Capt. Al Shinn of the Miss Belmar and Miss Belmar Princess. Al said he too had an up and down week because of the weather, and it seems like the weather reports hurt more than the actual weather. The best day of bluefishing was on Saturday when the slammers seemed to be everywhere on the surface of the water. During the week one day you wound hammer the blues, bonito, and Spanish mackerel, the next day you had to work for them. However when they turned on it was a real mad dog
localReport.scope: Raritan Bay, Sandy Hook, Monmouth County and nearby waters

localReport.title: LBI Fishing Report 9/10/26
localReport.summary: September 10, 2026 September fishing is underway on Long Beach Island and while the calendar says fall is getting close, the water is still holding onto summer. Warm and relatively clean / clear waters are present on the LBI surf with plenty of bait (spearing and other micro minnows). This has kept a diverse mix of fish around the LBI suds. localReport.title: Higbee’s Bait and Tackle-Southern New Jersey
localReport.summary: The Delaware Bay has been giving up plenty of keeper flounder this week according to Higbee’s Bait and Tackle. Several customers found a boat limit of fish to 22 inches while fishing minnows, spearing and squid strips. The party boats are seeing some decent catches of flounder while also having a mix of croaker’s, spots and blues, and recently black drum to 20 pounds.
